notes.title: My Lands strategy has been updated
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.mlgame.ru/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Grail-and-Sound-updated.jpg [/img]

Do you like strategy games, building cities and conquering lands? Then you indeed should put your skills to the test in My Lands game! 

Definitely you should, because it has been updated and the new estate Grail is now available on the map and can be conquered by you. The Grail is an Outer Estate that produces Black Gem currency for its owner. If you own the Grail, then you wield big power in your hands. The Grail is not a static object and changes its location from time to time. So you get a good chance to find it just next to your capital city. 

Along with the Grail we have introduced Sounds to My Lands and now you can enjoy our brand new music track that reflects the spirit of battles and conquers. Also, the new sounds for mouse clicks will definitely please the gamers.

We wish you great battles and vast lands
And see you in the My Lands game!

notes.title: Sounds and Grail will show up soon
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.mlgame.ru/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Grail-update.jpg [/img]
Hello, strategists and conquerors!
Here we are again to tell you the good news. The next great update will bring along 2 brand new features: Sounds and Grail! Wanna hear more?
Well first of all, we gonna have the original My Lands music and game sounds for all kinds of clicking. Sounds great, doesn't it?
Secondly, we will release the Grail - an Outer Estate similar to Salt Lakes but with one considerable advantage – an even faster production of Black Gems. The Grail is not a static object and changes its location from time to time. So you get a good chance to find it just next to your capital city. Seize this domain and you’ll definitely become the Scrooge McDuck of Black Gems.

Stay tuned and be ready for the next great update.

Keep up with our news and be the first!

notes.title: Contest: Review My Lands & Win cool DLC
notes.content:
Dear community,

We hasten to inform you that top DLC "Nomad" is NOW within arm`s reach!
Simply participate in our “Best Review” contest and win the “Nomad” set. Ready for the challenge? Then let`s go!
You just write an awesome yet helpful Review on My Lands game, post it in the Review tab and get upvotes. Who gets most upvotes will gain “Nomad” set.

We will announce the winner on October 23th. 
Participate, win DLC and build My Lands community together!

notes.title: Be ready for update in My Lands this Thursday!
notes.content:
Hey strategy fans!

We are happy to announce the first update to our Steam community!
Be ready for update this Thursday [b](2nd October)[/b] and meet new stuff that you will definitely like.

Update will include the following:
[list]
[*] Fixes of reported issues in payment process.
[*] Improvements of a game client interface and optimization of its performance.
[*] Support of new language - Norwegian. Hei!
[/list]

Stay tuned and follow [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/290730]“My Lands”[/url] updates
